headline: Rainforests cover just 6% of Earth's surface but host over half of all species
universal_truth: The right conditions create exponential abundance
fun_facts: A single hectare of rainforest can contain 400+ tree species—North America has about 700 total
Rainforest canopies are so thick that rain can take 10 minutes to reach the forest floor
We've only identified a fraction of rainforest species; countless remain undiscovered
discussion_questions: What conditions create abundance in your life?
Why does the rainforest produce so much more life than other ecosystems?
What undiscovered potential exists in environments you've overlooked?

hook.script: Enter a rainforest and life surrounds you—above, below, on every surface. More species live in one rainforest tree than in entire temperate forests. These jungles cover just 6% of Earth yet host more than half of all known species. Why is life so concentrated here?

cliff.script: Deserts and rainforests both get abundant sunlight. But one is sparse and one explodes with life. What makes the jungle so extraordinarily productive compared to every other ecosystem on Earth?

options.text: Constant warmth, abundant water, and stable climate allow year-round growth and specialization
options.response: Yes. No winter, constant rain, and stable conditions let species specialize in countless niches.

options.text: Ancient forests have had more time to evolve species
options.response: Age helps, but the conditions matter more...

fact1.title: Explosive Diversity
fact1.script: A single hectare—about 2.5 acres—of Amazon rainforest can contain 400 tree species. All of North America has roughly 700. Rainforests are biodiversity factories, producing new species through millennia of stable conditions and fierce competition.

fact2.title: Layered Worlds
fact2.script: Rainforests have distinct layers—forest floor, understory, canopy, and emergent layer—each with its own climate and residents. Some animals spend their entire lives in a single layer, never touching the ground or seeing the sky.

fact3.title: Unknown Species
fact3.script: Scientists estimate that 80% of species in rainforests remain undiscovered. New species are found regularly—insects, plants, even mammals. The rainforest is still being catalogued. We're losing species before we even know they exist.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: The right conditions create abundance. Warmth, water, stability—when these align, life explodes. Consider the conditions in your own life: what environment would help you flourish most?

outro.script: That's Day 60—sixty days of learning together! Welcome to March, our month exploring life science. Tomorrow, we'll discover the surprising power of grass. Until then, marvel at what becomes possible when conditions are right.

growTrack.title: Conditions Audit - Design for Flourishing
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify and create conditions that help you thrive
growTrack.activity: What are your rainforest conditions—the environments, situations, or relationships where you thrive most? List them. Then ask: how can I spend more time in these conditions? How can I bring these conditions into other areas of my life?
